direction: Original instrumental card-game score, recurring six-note motif, chamber orchestra and acoustic plucked instruments, no quotations of existing compositions. Audio generated from authored creative briefs, then locally mastered.

lobby.title: 金秋会客厅
lobby.creativeBrief: D major, 88 BPM, 6/8. Warm witty chamber folk: acoustic guitar/lute arpeggios, clarinet/flute lead, viola/cello and natural bass, sparse celesta and hand drum. D-F#-A-B-A-E motif, eight-bar question/answer. A theme, B minor development, richer A return. Natural dynamics and room sound; no vocals, chiptune, pop drums or existing melody.

battle.title: 底牌后出
battle.creativeBrief: D minor, 106 BPM, 4/4. Tactically playful chamber orchestra: pizzicato bass and short cello, interlocking spiccato strings, bassoon/clarinet question-answer, restrained French horns and frame/timpani/shaker percussion. D-F-A-Bb-A-E motif. Dm(add9)-Bbmaj7-Gm6-A7sus-A7, A/F-major B/A counterpoint form. Dynamic rests every eight bars; no vocals, EDM, harsh MIDI or known music.

tutorial.title: 第一张底牌

D-F#-A-B-A-E motif. A/B-minor variation/A form. Half the density of combat music, restrained dynamics, no voices or heavy drums.

danger.title: 最后一份底气
danger.creativeBrief: D minor, 106 BPM, 4/4. Same D-F-A-Bb-A-E motif under pressure: low-string ostinato, quiet viola sixteenths, spare woodwind, hopeful horn fragments, structural timpani and light syncopated tambourine. Dm-A7/C#-Bbmaj7-Gm6-A7 chromatic inner voice. Alternate tension, build, small peak and retreat every sixteen bars. No voices, horror noise or EDM.
